artifact.objective: episodic InfoNCE with TRAIN-only generic noise curriculum
artifact.pooling: frozen masked mean pooling followed by learned shared projection

dense_plateau.late_interaction_reason: not permitted: at least one dense intervention materially improved held-out robustness

external_evaluation_integrity.overlap_interpretation: schema-held-out development evidence; not claimed as pristine blind evidence

failure_decomposition.method: deterministic diagnostic rules on permitted CLINC150 train schema-held-out rows

promotion_reason: the development-selected RB1 regressed full clean schema-held-out Recall@8 and matched end-to-end accuracy, while multi-view latency increased without a significant aggregate gain

structured_field_ablation.rules: recursive scalar extraction excluding generic IDs, timestamps, hashes, versions, attempts, and display settings

causal_readout.adaptive: bounded tail/middle views restore position coverage without changing the encoder
causal_readout.long_prefix: useful span is removed by right truncation in the single-view path
causal_readout.long_suffix: useful span remains visible; degradation is consistent with pooling/noise dominance

winner_query_policy: Q0_single (Pareto choice; multi-view gains were within noise)
